findings.finding: nc_get_att_double can write multiple attribute elements into a scalar c_double; malformed vector-valued attribute can overwrite native memory.
findings.recommendation: Query nc_inq_attlen, require exactly1, then validate finite scalar values before decode.
findings.resolution: scalar_attribute queries nc_inq_attlen and requires one element before native copy; rejects other errors and nonfinite data. Decoder checks positive scale and int16 fill; runtime checks exact fixed layout, finite scaling and pinned file hash.

other_observations: Country count conservation, positive world residual separation and population fidelity counts are explicit. No observed count inflation through promotion/demotion.
Geography is explicitly overview-scale; terrain does not claim ellipsoid datum, street collision or maritime safety.

verification.review_scope: source and regression tests for reported issue, not complete security audit
